text:
Elena: Customer X requested a controlled EU+APAC rollout with strict token-spend ceilings and a clear rollback ladder. Need a compact spec we can hand to infra + SRE today.
Vik: Proposal in bullets: regional canaries (EU then APAC), per-tenant token budgets, and an A/B economics check before full ramp. Keep enterprise accounts opt-in for week 1.
Tom: Ops constraints: APAC evenings are high-util. Schedule APAC slices only 02:00-06:00 UTC or weekend windows. Also require per-tenant max-reqs/min and per-tenant hourly token caps.
Rae: Safety ladder idea: (1) auto-route affected traffic to stable model; (2) flip regional rollout flag off; (3) global freeze + alert oncall. Automate via flag-bot. Use 3 consecutive 5m windows to confirm trips.
June: Data asks for live-eval: 300 synthetic prompts/hr + 300 sampled real queries/hr. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate, embedding cosine drift, answer-length change, and token cost per request. Quality gate: embedding drift > 0.025 OR length change > 15% -> trip.
Vik: Draft YAML snippet (pseudo):
```
rollout_name: eu-apac-phased-v2
phases:
  - name: eu-canary
    region: eu
    tenant_size: small
    pct: 2
    duration: 4h
  - name: apac-canary
    region: apac
    tenant_size: small
    pct: 1
    duration: 4h (night/weekend only)
  - name: ab-econ
    sample_pct: 5
    duration: 48h
telemetry_gates:
  latency_p95_increase_pct: 30
  error_rate_abs: 0.5
  embedding_drift: 0.025
economics_gates:
  token_cost_increase_pct: 12
  daily_spend_threshold_usd: 1200
flags:
  key: rollout.eu_apac.phased.v2
  per_tenant_opt_in: true
  allow_manual_override: true
fallback_sequence:
  - model: stable-v1
  - flag: rollout.eu_apac.phased.v2=0
  - global_freeze: true
```
Tom: Token-shed rules: if tenant_hourly_tokens > tenant_budget*0.95 -> downgrade that tenant to quantized-variant; if still above after 10m -> serve cached token-limited response. Add a burst throttle knob (2x for 10m) with auto-expire.
Rae: Hysteresis: after fallback, lock re-enable for min 10m and require 3 clean 5m windows. All events must include correlation id and be posted to #oncall-rollouts.
Vik: Implementation notes: immutable flag names for audit; routing decisions must revert in <30s. Contract tests for function-calling payloads with fallback model required. Example smoke: `POST /internal/test/roundtrip` with sample payloads.
June: For A/B stats, compute per-cohort average embedding score and cost; require p < 0.05 for claims of improvement or acceptability. Generate executive summary after canary with pass/continue/rollback rec.
Elena: Communications: banner in-console 72h prior, email 48h prior, and per-account approval webhook for enterprise opt-ins. Tom, can you draft ops runbook snippets?
Tom: Yep. Example rollback CLI: `curl -X POST https://api.internal/flags/rollout.eu_apac.phased.v2 -d '{"value":0}'` and routing fallback: `POST /internal/routing/fallback {"rollout":"eu-apac-phased-v2","target":"stable-v1"}`. Will add full steps.
flag-bot: Canary started: rollout=eu-apac-phased-v2 slice=eu-small pct=2 start=6212345678
Elena: Please add blockers to the shared doc by EOD. We'll finalize gating numbers Monday 10:00 UTC. Thanks all :rocket:
